text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, look at all your tasks and prioritise them. Which ones are most urgent or important? Do those first. It also helps to manage the scope of your work. If a project is too big, break it into smaller steps, or agree to do less. Communication is just as important. If you think you might miss a deadline, tell your manager or team early. They may be able to help or give you more time. By planning your time, prioritising tasks, controlling the scope, and speaking up, you can handle deadlines with less stress.
